slides.title: Zero Dependencies
slides.description: No external libraries required. Everything is self-contained in a single ~250KB bundle.
slides.code:
<script src="domma.min.js"></script>
// That's it. You're ready to go!

slides.title: jQuery-Style DOM API
slides.description: Familiar $() syntax with 90+ chainable methods for traversal, manipulation, events, and effects.

slides.title: Template Engine
slides.description: Mustache-style templates with loops, conditionals, partials, and auto-escaping built in.

slides.title: Lodash-Compatible Utils
slides.description: 120+ utility functions for arrays, objects, strings, and functions — all via the _ alias.

slides.title: Moment-Style Dates
slides.description: Chainable date manipulation with formatting, parsing, comparison, and relative time.

slides.title: Reactive Models
slides.description: Pub/sub events, schema validation, and two-way DOM binding for reactive data.

slides.title: UI Components
slides.description: Ready-to-use modals, tabs, accordions, carousels, tooltips, and toasts.

slides.title: DataTable-Like Tables
slides.description: Sorting, filtering, pagination, row selection, and CSV/JSON export built in.

slides.title: Mutable Configuration
slides.description: Setup once, update anytime. Inspect and reset configuration at runtime.

slides.title: 100+ SVG Icons
slides.description: Built-in icon library with render, inject, and scan modes. Customisable size and colour.

slides.title: Theme System
slides.description: Light/dark modes with 8 colour variants. Auto-detects system preference and persists choices.

slides.title: Visual Effects
slides.description: CSS-powered glow, fireworks, and shadow effects. Pure CSS implementation for performance.
slides.code:
Glowing Title

Elevated

slides.title: Forms Module
slides.description: Schema-driven form generation with validation, wizards, and complete CRUD operations.

slides.title: HTTP Client
slides.description: Fetch-based HTTP client with promise API. GET, POST, PUT, DELETE with automatic JSON handling.

slides.title: Storage Wrapper
slides.description: localStorage wrapper with auto JSON serialisation, namespaced keys, and graceful fallbacks.

slides.title: Model Persistence
slides.description: Models auto-save to localStorage. Load state on page refresh, reset to defaults anytime.

slides.title: 100+ Unit Tests
slides.description: Comprehensive test suite covering all modules: DOM, utils, dates, models, storage, tables, elements, and more.
slides.code:
# Run tests in browser
open tests/test.html
# DOM, Utils, Dates, Models, Storage...

slides.title: CSS Grid System
slides.description: Bootstrap-style 12-column grid plus modern CSS Grid utilities. Mobile-first, responsive breakpoints.

slides.title: CSS-Free Usage
slides.description: Use Domma's JS with your own CSS framework. Disable theming entirely for Bootstrap, Tailwind, or custom styles.

slides.title: Blueprint-Centric Architecture
slides.description: Define your schema once and use it everywhere: forms, models, tables, and CRUD operations.
slides.code:
const schema = { name: M.types.string, email: M.types.email };
F.create(schema); // Auto-generate form
M.create(schema); // Reactive model
F.crud('#app', schema, { api: '/api/users' }); // Complete CRUD
